narrative.overview: tambo is a control panel that feels like a dim machine room with one warm lamp on: a warm brown-tinted near-black ground, hairline borders doing the structural work, and a single committed madder-orange accent that appears only where the operator acts or a state demands attention. It is deliberately angular — a corner scale of 0/2/4/6 with 4px as the ceiling on controls and 6px on surfaces — so nothing reads pillowy or default-SaaS. Depth is real but quiet: offset-plus-blur shadows only on overlays; everything else stands on 1px hairlines against the ground. The light theme is the same dye lots dipped for daylight, not a separate palette.
keyCharacteristics: Warm brown-black grounds (undyed alpaca), never blue-black slate
One accent: madder #e2622c; status colors stay distinct from it
Radius scale 0/2/4/6, pill reserved for toggle tracks only
Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for all data with tabular numerals
Hairline borders convey structure; shadows reserved for elevation events

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Madder is the only brand hue; it stays on actions, active state, and data accents — status colors never borrow from it.

rules.name: The Dye-Lot Rule
rules.body: Both themes are the same palette family: a role changes value between themes, never meaning.

rules.name: The Data Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: If it is a filename, size, port, pid, rate, or command, it is JetBrains Mono. Prose never is.

rules.name: The Hairlines-First Rule
rules.body: A border or a tonal step resolves separation; a box-shadow appears only when something genuinely floats above the page.

dos: Do keep every corner on the 0/2/4/6 scale; 4px on controls, 6px on surfaces.
Do set all data in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals; keep prose in Inter.
Do convey structure with 1px hairlines on the tinted neutrals (#362d24 / #2a231c).
Do use translucent semantic fills for badges and callouts, color-mix at 30–32% for their borders.
Do darken the accent exactly one dip for the light theme (madder → #b8451a).
Do keep contrast at AA: accent-as-text uses #f0854f on dark, danger text #e86a76.
donts: Don't introduce rounded-full or >6px radii on any control or surface (pill is toggle tracks only).
Don't use shadows for panel separation; that is hairline work.
Don't add icon fonts or third-party icon glyphs; draw 1.5-stroke SVGs only.
Don't tint grounds blue or grey; grounds are brown-tinted (#14100c family).
Don't use the accent for status; ok/warn/bad/info have their own dye lots.
Don't letter-case Inter as a faux label; labels are mono, uppercase, tracked 0.04em, trailed by a rule.
Don't render gradient text, glyph icons, or hard neobrutalist offset shadows.
